writing_contract: Write one finished Binance Square post, never an outline, briefing or instructions.

Use a clear sequence: HOOK → NEW INFORMATION → INTERPRETATION → DECISION. Technical: HOOK → EVIDENCE → LEVEL/SCENARIO → QUESTION. News: EVENT → WHY IT MATTERS → MARKET RESPONSE → QUESTION. Flow: REGIME → RELATIVE STRENGTH → FLOW EVIDENCE → CONDITIONAL SETUP → INVALIDATION → QUESTION. Research: ANOMALY → EVIDENCE → MISSING DATA → WATCH CONDITION → QUESTION.
Every paragraph must add new information or a decision. Never paraphrase the headline as the body.
Use one or two strong supplied facts instead of a statistics dump.
Exactly one question, and it must be the supplied story-specific question at the end.
For NEWS: use verified event/source only and never infer BTC relevance without supplied evidence.
For TECHNICAL: use only supplied OHLCV levels; do not invent support/resistance, targets or stops.

No artificial engagement, no copied wording and no creator imitation.
Do not force emojis; use them only when they improve the joke or readability.
Use exact supplied facts only.

fresh_news.title: White hats outrun Coldcard hackers in 52-Bitcoin evacuation
fresh_news.summary: White hats secured about 40% of the Bitcoin moved in the Coldcard exploit’s second wave, transferring it to a Wyoming trust for victims.

fresh_news.title: Binance probed by U.S. federal prosecutors for sanctions violations: Bloomberg
fresh_news.summary: Federal prosecutors in Manhattan and the Justice Department are said to be investigating whether the crypto exchange knowingly permitted users to bypass U.S. sanctions on Iran.

fresh_news.title: Google and Apple seek crypto talent as Big Tech eyes stablecoin and tokenization rails
fresh_news.summary: The tech giants’ job listings could indicate that they are separately pursuing experts in stablecoins and tokenized deposits for future projects.

fresh_news.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent champions dollar dominance across global markets and stablecoins
fresh_news.summary: Bessent pushed back against a bearish assessment of the U.S. economy highlighting strong growth, foreign demand for American assets and continued dollar dominance.

fresh_news.title: Why this investment bank expects little demand for tokenized stocks despite SEC’s new trading rules
fresh_news.summary: TD Cowen expects limited demand for tokenized stocks despite new SEC rules opening a path for trading outside traditional markets.

fresh_news.title: Ondo lets institutions convert stocks directly into tokenized shares
fresh_news.summary: Ondo’s new in-kind conversion system allows approved institutions to mint and redeem tokenized stocks and ETFs using the underlying securities instead of cash.

fresh_news.title: Trueo prediction market moves from Base to Ethereum
fresh_news.summary: Trueo said Base was the right choice when it launched, as Ethereum gas fees were higher, but said mainnet now offers greater integration potential.

fresh_news.title: Kakao Pay, KakaoBank to explore stablecoin opportunities with Fireblocks
fresh_news.summary: Kakao Pay and KakaoBank are exploring digital asset opportunities with Fireblocks, including infrastructure for stablecoins.

fresh_news.title: Why banks and offshore hubs like Dubai are winners of the Senate killing the Clarity Act
fresh_news.summary: One expert believes that the failure to pass the bill is a win for the banks that staunchly oppose stablecoin yields, while a global crypto lawyer believes overseas jurisdictions benefit.

fresh_news.title: Whitehats move 52 bitcoin from the Coldcard hack to a recovery trust
fresh_news.summary: According to Galaxy Digital, the good guys have moved 52 BTC to an address carrying an OP_RETURN message reading "claim:cryptorecoverytrust dot com."

fresh_news.title: ECB launches Pontes to settle tokenized assets without stablecoins
fresh_news.summary: Pontes will expand its services and operating hours gradually, with full implementation expected by 2028 and more participants set to join.

fresh_news.title: Circle launches Bitcoin-backed USDC borrowing for institutional clients
fresh_news.summary: Circle is bringing Bitcoin-backed borrowing to institutional clients, allowing them to tap BTC holdings for USDC liquidity without selling their Bitcoin.
